text: The air conditioning in room 304 made loud clanking noises all night and could not be adjusted below 26 degrees Celsius. Front desk could not move us because the hotel was fully booked.
author: Oliver Bennett

text: Arrived for our confirmed 4 PM couples massage at the spa, only to be told by reception that Booking.com double-booked the time slot. Very disappointing start to our anniversary weekend.
author: Sophie Laurent

text: Breakfast buffet was crowded and the single espresso machine had a long queue with a 20-minute wait. Adding a second barista station during weekend mornings is urgently needed.
author: Giorgio Bellini

text: Housekeeping missed restocking towels and bath amenities on day two of our stay. Had to call the concierge twice before replacement bathrobes were brought up.
author: Liam Patterson

text: The room thermostat display kept flashing error code E3 and blowing warm air. Maintenance staff tried to fix it twice but the problem persisted throughout our stay.
author: Beatrice Colombo

text: Spa reservation was lost in their system even though I showed the confirmation email from the hotel booking portal.
author: Martina Rinaldi

text: Beautiful historic building and prime location in Rome, but recurring air conditioning failures in third-floor rooms ruin the luxury experience.
author: Patrick O'Connor

text: Breakfast service was chaotic. Tables remained uncleared for 15 minutes while guests waited with plates in hand.
author: Francesca Morelli

text: Bathroom shower drain was clogged and drained very slowly, causing water to pool onto the marble floor.
author: Henrik Lindqvist
